notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle and Gutter Grime.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, putting a slime counter on it and creating an X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return the nontoken creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Ooze, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
